overview:
Democrats defend an open Illinois House seat that leans Democratic by about five points. Raja Krishnamoorthi is leaving to run for U.S. Senate, and Melissa Bean enters as the Democratic nominee with strong fundraising — about $2.5 million raised — plus roughly $5.5 million in outside support. Republican Jennifer Davis has raised about $1.8 million, with no recorded outside support on her side.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the national climate, both of which favor Democrats. Prediction markets put Democratic win odds around 95 percent. A Democratic-leaning seat, a favorable environment, and Bean's resource edge make her the clear favorite, though an open seat without polling carries more uncertainty than a race with an incumbent on the ballot.
